findings.title: Support, moderation and feedback cases cannot be linked
findings.summary: Fresh source handoff regression remains: Support Link operational case, Feedback Link operational case and Moderation Open linked case all open a new-case form despite their canonical source IDs already being linked to CASE-20260914-0BDDAF. The dialog has no existing-case selector. Support and moderation handoff dialogs were reviewed at all six sizes. Feedback selected-detail still collapses to a single-character column at 1024x768, with workflow controls clipped on the right.

Inspect moderation dialog at all six sizes; cancel and verify original case remains version17.
